description: Everything EclipseMission holds on one place, each figure with its source and reading day: the eclipse (duration, and contact times where our oracle has them), lodging (eclipse week, week after, the two eclipse nights, solo traveller and hostels where measured, with the ten prices behind each mean), sky, heat, entry regime by passport, the cost of the observation itself, access and the airfares read to its airport.

destination.description: The destination key, as list_destinations returns it.

passport.description: ISO code of the traveller's passport: returns that passport's entry regime in full. Without it, one short line per passport we cover.

name: get_destination
title: Every figure for one destination
